Package arcade.patch.agent.process

Class PatchProcessSensingHypoxic

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcess
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcessSensing
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcessSensingHypoxic
All Implemented Interfaces:
Process
public class PatchProcessSensingHypoxic extends PatchProcessSensing
Extension of PatchProcessSensing for hypoxic sensing.

The PatchProcessSensingHypoxic process adds VEGF to the environment, based on the energy level of the cell. If a cell's energy is below 0 (energy-deficient and quiescent), VEGF is added to the environment at the rate specified by the input parameter VEGF_SECRETION_RATE.
